dedupe_keys.name: miad synthetic outdoor maintenance inspection images

description: MIAD publishes more than 100,000 high-resolution synthetic colour images for outdoor maintenance inspection. Its project page lists seven scenarios: electrical insulators, metal welding, photovoltaics, wind turbines, catenary droppers, nuts and bolts, and witness marks. Pixel-precise labels cover surface and logical anomalies. Each scenario has linked Google Drive and Baidu routes; the electrical-insulator Drive archive displayed publicly during this review. The page states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and no charge. Coverage is generated 3D scenes, not photographed facilities, with no geographic site, physical observation period or real sampling interval. A limitation is that synthetic backgrounds and defects may not describe field prevalence or weather damage accurately. Simulation use includes testing visual-observation modules for energy and rail maintenance models. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with scene images, not equipment sensor histories. Dataset archives and model results were not downloaded or tested.
name: MIAD synthetic outdoor maintenance-inspection images
notes: G8; G8-0616. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.  Cited as: Bao and colleagues (2023). MIAD: A Maintenance Inspection Dataset for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection. ICCV 2023 Workshop; arXiv:2211.13968..
